summary: Verified the /markets empty-table bug fix. Backend /api/market/coins and /api/market/chart endpoints respond 200 fast (<400ms) from the disk-persisted cache. Frontend /markets renders ~25 rows per page with real EUR prices (BTC 68.782 €, ETH, USDT, BNB, XRP, USDC, SOL, ...), 24h change, market cap, 24h volume and sparkline charts. Regression on /markets/bitcoin (price 68.829,00 €, chart with 1D/1W/1M/6M/2Y toggles, TOC sidebar, all sections) and /business (hero coins, cards) also passes.

issues: Newsletter 'Bleiben Sie informiert' modal auto-opens on every page load and overlays the content. Not blocking (page renders behind), but intrusive during QA. Already noted in iteration_2.

critical_code_review_comments: market_data.py disk-cache flush is only triggered on _store() when >20s since last flush; if the process is killed between stores the newest entries can be lost. Minor given SWR refills it after boot.
_cached() raises 503 only when there is literally no cached entry; the frontend retry loop handles this gracefully. Good design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Markets bug is FIXED. Backend serves from /app/backend/.cache/market_cache.json on cold start, so even a 429 storm after restart does not blank the UI. One stray 503 was seen in console (likely a specific chart range still warming) but Markets.tsx retry loop handles it. Newsletter modal still auto-opens — dismiss via the X button or inject localStorage before screenshots.
rca of the issue: N/A — bug already fixed by main agent. Verified.
